verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents 700+ pre-built connectors spanning SaaS apps, databases, event streams, and files, with per-connector setup guides and automated schema/API handling, plus a Connector SDK for gaps. Community feedback corroborates reliable syncing across many source types, reinforcing the breadth claim. Missing for 10: no independent third-party benchmark of connector freshness/coverage breadth beyond vendor docs and anecdotal HN mentions.
